definition_zh: 大包；大捆；（古义）灾祸；悲痛
definition_en: a large bound bundle of goods such as hay or cotton; also, an archaic word for evil or sorrow
core_image: 田野尽头码得整整齐齐的方形草捆
scene: 拖拉机把最后一捆干草推上垛顶。The crew loaded bales of cotton onto the flatbed.
sceneCN: 这里 bale 指「大包、大捆」（第 1 个义项：打包成捆的货物）；句意：工人们把一捆捆棉花装上平板车。

pos.zh: 大包；大捆；（废义）灾祸；悲伤

derivatives.zh: 有害的；凶恶的（出自古义 bale「灾祸」+ -ful）

senses.title: A large bound bundle
senses.definition: a large quantity of a compressible good pressed and tied into a block
senses.definitionCN: 可压缩货物被压实捆扎成的大块
senses.example: Hay bales dotted the field after harvest.
senses.exampleCN: 收割后，干草捆星星点点布满田野。
senses.why: The commercial root is Middle Dutch bale, a pack of goods.
senses.whyCN: 商业词根是中古荷兰语 bale「货包」。

senses.title: A standard trade unit
senses.definition: a fixed weight or measure of cotton, wool, or paper used in trade
senses.definitionCN: 棉花、羊毛、纸张等在贸易中固定的重量单位
senses.example: Cotton is quoted per bale on the exchange.
senses.exampleCN: 交易所以每包为单位报棉花价格。
senses.why: Trade standardized the bundle into a unit of account.
senses.whyCN: 贸易把草捆标准化为记账单位。

senses.title: To press and tie into bundles
senses.definition: to compress and bind a material into bales
senses.definitionCN: 把材料压实并捆成大包
senses.exampleCN: 志愿者把纸板打包回收。
senses.why: The noun made a verb of itself, as goods nouns do.
senses.whyCN: 货物名词自我动词化，一如常态。

senses.title: Bale out, to jump from a plane
senses.definition: in British use, to parachute from a disabled aircraft
senses.definitionCN: 英式用法，从失控飞机跳伞
senses.example: The pilot baled out at eight hundred feet.
senses.exampleCN: 飞行员在八百英尺高空跳伞。
senses.why: Distinct from bail out; British spelling keeps the e.
senses.whyCN: 与 bail out 有别；英式拼写保留 e。

senses.title: Archaic: evil or harm
senses.definition: in archaic English, mischief, sorrow, or destruction
senses.definitionCN: 古英语中指祸患、悲恸或毁灭
senses.example: The poet sang of woe and bale.
senses.why: A native Germanic word, unrelated to the bundle.
senses.whyCN: 这是本族日耳曼词，与「货包」毫无关系。

senses.title: Archaic: burning, as hell-fire
senses.definition: in old poetry, fire, especially the flames of hell
senses.definitionCN: 古诗中指火焰，尤指地狱之火
senses.example: Sermons painted the bale of the damned.
senses.exampleCN: 布道描绘受诅者的地狱之火。
senses.why: A second native homograph, from a word to burn.
senses.whyCN: 第二个同形本族词，源自「燃烧」一词。

senses.title: Baleful, the survival of old bale
senses.definition: the adjective baleful preserves the archaic sorrow-and-harm sense
senses.definitionCN: 形容词 baleful 保存了古义的「灾殃、伤害」
senses.example: A baleful stare stopped the argument.
senses.exampleCN: 一道凶狠的目光让争论戛然而止。
senses.why: The noun died, but its adjective lives on in daily use.
senses.whyCN: 名词已死，其形容词却活跃至今。

senses.title: Baled waste, the modern industry
senses.definition: compressed recyclables, from cardboard to scrap metal
senses.definitionCN: 从纸板到废金属的压块回收物
senses.example: The yard stacked baled aluminum by the ton.
senses.exampleCN: 回收场按吨堆放压块的铝料。
senses.why: The oldest commercial sense found a green second life.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的商业义在回收业获得新生。

intro.en: English has two bales: the bundle, from Middle Dutch bale or Old French bale, a pack for transport; and the sorrow, from Old English bealu, evil or destruction, cognate with the first element of the names Böðvarr and Baldwin in their Germanic forms.
intro.cn: 英语有两个 bale：「货包」出自中古荷兰语 bale 或古法语 bale，指运输货包；「灾殃」出自古英语 bealu「邪恶、毁灭」，与日耳曼人名中的 Baldwin 等词的首成分同源。

items.en: The sorrow-root is reconstructed as balu-, harm or destruction.
items.cn: 「灾殃」词根被重构为 balu-「伤害、毁灭」。

items.en: bealu meant evil, wickedness, or destruction, a strong poetic word.
items.cn: 古英语 bealu 指邪恶、残暴或毁灭，是强的诗歌用词。

items.en: The bundle-word crossed from Middle Dutch bale, a pack of merchandise.
items.cn: 「货包」一词由中古荷兰语 bale「商货包」传入。

items.en: The trading bale entered English by the fourteenth century with the wool trade.
items.cn: 14 世纪随羊毛贸易，商业 bale 进入英语。

items.en: The verb to bale is recorded from the sixteenth century.
items.cn: 动词 to bale 见于 16 世纪记载。

items.en: The sorrow-bale survives only in baleful; the bundle-bale thrives in farm and scrapyard.
items.cn: 「灾殃」义仅存于 baleful；「货包」义活跃于农场与回收场。

note.en: Group one gathers the homograph pair and the bail family; group two gathers bundle and doom words.
note.cn: 第一组收同形词对与 bail 词族；第二组收货包与厄运义场的词。

entries.definition: to scoop water, post bond, or (US) jump from a plane; the eternal spelling trap.
entries.definitionCN: 舀水、保释或（美）跳伞；与 bale 同音，永恒的拼写陷阱。

entries.definition: sinister and harmful; the living descendant of bealu.
entries.definitionCN: 凶恶有害的；bealu 的存世后裔。

entries.definition: ship's weighting cargo, from the same Low-German trading world.
entries.definitionCN: 船舶压舱物；出自同一低地德语商贸圈。

entries.definition: a loosely tied group of things.
a bound bundle of grain stalks.
a wrapped or boxed quantity for carrying.
deep sorrow; the modern cousin of old bale.
entries.definitionCN: 深重的悲哀；古义 bale 的现代近亲。
彻底毁灭，尤指永罚；古义 bale 的近亲。

normalIntro.en: Two bales share one sound: the farmer's bundle and the poet's sorrow.
normalIntro.cn: 两个 bale 同音：农人的货包与诗人的哀愁。

normal.en: a bale of hay: the everyday phrase.
normal.cn: a bale of hay 是日常搭配。

normal.en: British bale out, American bail out, for parachutes.
normal.cn: 跳伞英式用 bale out，美式用 bail out。

normal.en: baleful comes from the other bale: evil, sorrow.
normal.cn: baleful 出自另一个 bale：邪恶、悲恸。

normal.en: Baler, the machine, doubles as an Australian town name.
normal.cn: 打捆机 baler 恰与澳大利亚地名 Baler 同拼。

normal.en: Spelling check: the bundle has the e, bale.
normal.cn: 拼写检查：货包义带 e，作 bale。

abstract.en: See twine bite into a golden cube.
abstract.cn: 看麻绳咬进金色的方块。

abstract.en: Old bale is the ash-word from the fire sermons.
abstract.cn: 古义 bale 是火刑布道里烧剩的灰词。

abstract.en: Hear the baling machine sigh at the end of the field.
abstract.cn: 听打捆机在田头的长叹。

examples.en: The loft held forty bales of straw.
examples.cn: 草棚里堆着四十捆麦秸。

examples.en: Mill workers baled the rags for shipment north.
examples.cn: 磨坊工人把破布打包北运。

examples.en: The chronicle speaks of fire and bale upon the town.
examples.cn: 编年史记载大火与灾殃降临城池。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「贝耦」——两捆贝壳用绳子耦在一起，就成了大包

root: 英语中有两个同形 bale：一为「货包」，14 世纪经中古荷兰语 bale 或古法语 bale 进入英语，与羊毛贸易相关；一为「灾殃、悲恸」，出自古英语 bealu「邪恶、毁灭」，词根可追溯至原始日耳曼语 balu-，另有一个表「火」的同源古词。今前者通行，后者仅存于形容词 baleful。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses split along the homograph seam: the farming and trading bundle on one side, and the archaic sorrow and fire on the other, with baleful as the living bridge.
sensesIntro.cn: 八义项沿同形词的裂缝分开：一边是农牧贸易的货包，另一边是古义的悲恸与烈火，baleful 则是存活的桥梁。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a compressed cube tied tight, and, underneath the word, an older flame.
core.cn: 核心意象：捆得紧紧的方块；而在词的底层，埋着一团更古老的火。

branches.en: THE FARM SIDE: hay, straw, and baled recyclables.
branches.cn: 农牧一面：干草、麦秸与压块回收物。

branches.en: THE TRADE SIDE: the bale as a unit of price.
branches.cn: 贸易一面：作为计价单位的包。

branches.en: THE AVIATION SIDE: bale out in British skies.
branches.cn: 航空一面：英国空军说的 bale out。

branches.en: THE ARCHAIC SIDE: sorrow surviving in baleful.
branches.cn: 古义一面：存于 baleful 中的悲恸。

branches.en: THE FIRE SIDE: hell-fire of the lost homograph.
branches.cn: 烈火一面：另一同形词的地狱之火。

intro.en: Neither bale takes affixes of its own; both are bare roots that borrowed English endings.
intro.cn: 两个 bale 本身都不带词缀，皆为裸词根，只借英语词尾。

latinIntro.en: No Latin here: one bale is Low-German trade speech, the other native Old English poetry.
latinIntro.cn: 与拉丁语无关：一个 bale 是低地德语的商贸语，另一个是古英语诗歌本族词。
